aboutGame.title: What is Haze Seas?
paragraphs: Haze Seas is a free Roblox Action RPG developed by [HS] Haze Studios and launched as a major rebuild of Haze Piece. Players choose a Pirate or Marine path, complete island quests, assign stats, and fight with Devil Fruits, swords, fighting styles, and Haki.

The current game features 35 Devil Fruits and progression across three seas. Its long-term loop is to level up, hunt rare boss drops, unlock stronger forms and V2 upgrades, and refine a PvE or PvP build with friends or a crew.

modules.name: Haze Seas Beginner Guide
modules.description: Start efficiently in Haze Seas, formerly Haze Piece, by following island quests instead of grinding random enemies and by committing to one main damage path. The guide connects codes, Fruit acquisition, stats, bosses, Haki, and later sea progression in the order a new player encounters them.

highlights.detail: Redeem active codes and claim available starter rewards before beginning the main grind.
Complete quests on the current island; when the level requirement is met, the game highlights the next destination.
Choose one primary damage stat: Fruit, Sword, or Combat, then keep Defense as the secondary investment.
Get a Fruit from Cynthia for 125,000 Cash or 50 Gems per random roll, or watch for tree spawns every 60 minutes.
Defeat island bosses along the quest route for additional EXP, Cash, and chances at weapons or accessories.
Unlock Buso Haki at Level 350 and Observation Haki at Level 600 as soon as their requirements are met.

modules.name: Haze Seas Haki Guide
modules.description: Learn how to unlock and upgrade Armament, Observation, and Conqueror's Haki with exact level, Cash, race, and trainer requirements. This section directly answers high-intent searches such as how to get Haki, Buso Level 2, and Observation Haki in Haze Seas or Haze Piece.

highlights.label: Armament Haki
highlights.detail: Buy Level 1 from Old Man Silver in Logue City at Level 350 for 100,000 Cash; it boosts Sword and Fighting Style damage and lets you hit Logia users.

highlights.label: Observation Haki
highlights.detail: Buy Level 1 from the trainer in Marine Base Town at Level 600 for 150,000 Cash; it starts with three automatic dodges.

highlights.label: Conquerors Haki
highlights.detail: Automatically unlocks only with the D. Clan race; each use costs 250 Stamina, reduced to 200 with D. Clan V2.

modules.name: Haze Seas Bosses and Drops
modules.description: Find each boss location, summon requirement, respawn window, and confirmed drop before starting a farm. The complete guide covers Island Bosses and Super Bosses, including high-demand legacy Haze Piece searches for G4, Mace, Sea Beast, Enma, and Dough Boss.

highlights.detail: G4 Boss — Spawns on Bubble Island, returns 30 seconds after defeat, and has a 5% chance to drop the Gear 4 Book.
Mace Boss — A Level 700 Super Boss in the cave behind Marine Base Town; place Lava Ore in the cauldron to summon it for Mace V1 and Coded Mask drops.
Sea Beast — The Sea 1 version spawns at Rocky Pillars every 30 to 120 minutes, drops a Sea Beast Core, and has a 50% chance for Sea Beast Hammer V1.
Enma Boss — A Level 2500 Super Boss at Flower Capital in Sea 2 with a 60-minute respawn and a 10% chance to drop the Enma Sword.
Dough Boss — Spawned in Mirror World for 50 Gems; it has a 120-minute respawn, a 10% Dough Scarf drop, and a 50% Dough Trident drop.

modules.name: Haze Seas Sea 2 and Sea 3
modules.description: Follow the current unlock path from the First Sea to the Second and Third Seas. This progression guide also covers legacy Haze Piece searches for Sea 2, Poneglyph Scroll, Gatekeeper, Red Emperor, and Sea 3.

highlights.detail: Reach Level 2200 before accepting the Sea 2 quest.
Talk to the Dimensional Sailor at the Starter Island docks, then enter the central cave at Rocky Pillars and collect the Poneglyph Scroll.
Return the Poneglyph Scroll to the Dimensional Sailor and interact with him again to teleport to Sea 2.
Reach Level 4200, then find the Gatekeeper inside the main building at Flower Capital in Sea 2.
Choose the Sea 3 challenge and fight the Red Emperor alone until the victory cutscene triggers.
Return to the Gatekeeper, select Yes, and travel to the Land of the Gods starter island in Sea 3.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Haze Seas.

items.question: What is Haze Seas?
items.answer: Haze Seas is a free Roblox Action RPG developed by [HS] Haze Studios and launched as a major rebuild of Haze Piece on June 30, 2026. Players explore islands, master Devil Fruits and Haki, collect weapons, and challenge bosses across three seas.

items.question: Is Haze Seas free to play?
items.answer: Yes, Haze Seas is a free-to-play Roblox experience available on PC, Mobile, and Xbox. You can join via the official Roblox page and start playing immediately.

items.question: How do I redeem codes in Haze Seas?
items.answer: Open the Roblox game, find the in-game Shop or Codes menu, enter the code exactly as shown, and confirm. Rewards such as EXP boosts, Race Spins, Gems, and Stat Refunds are added to your account instantly.

items.question: What is the best fruit in Haze Seas?
items.answer: Dragon, Dough, Gum with Gear 4 or Gear 5, Darkness, Phoenix, Electricity, and Tremor are the most commonly cited S-tier Fruits in Haze Seas for grinding, bosses, and PvP.

items.question: How do I progress from Sea 1 to Sea 2 and Sea 3?
items.answer: Reach Level 2200 to unlock Sea 2, then find the Dimensional Sailor at Starter Island docks, collect the Poneglyph Scroll in Rocky Pillars cave, and return it to teleport to Sea 2. For Sea 3, reach Level 4200 and defeat the Red Emperor at Flower Capital.

items.question: Where do I find active codes for Haze Seas?
items.answer: The Codes page on this wiki tracks Haze Seas codes from the official Roblox description, official Discord announcements, and official Haze Studios YouTube channel. Always verify codes in-game before relying on them.

redemption.h2: Cómo canjear códigos de Haze Seas
steps: Abre Haze Seas en Roblox y carga tu personaje.
Pulsa el botón Menú en la esquina inferior izquierda de la pantalla.
Selecciona el icono blanco del Cofre del Tesoro o Regalo.
Pega el código en el campo Introducir Código con las mayúsculas exactas mostradas arriba.
Pulsa el botón verde Canjear para reclamar la recompensa.

troubleshooting.h2: Why is a Haze Seas code not working?

items.title: Invalid Code
items.body: Check capitalization and remove spaces before or after the code.

items.title: Already Redeemed
items.body: Each code can normally be used once per Roblox account.

items.title: No Reward Appeared
items.body: Rejoin a newly started server and try once more. If the code still fails, it may have expired.

faq.question: Are Haze Seas and Haze Piece codes the same?
faq.answer: Haze Seas is the rebuilt version of Haze Piece. Use the current Haze Seas list above; old Haze Piece codes belong in the expired section unless the developers reactivate them.

faq.question: Are Haze Seas codes case-sensitive?
faq.answer: Yes. Copy the capitalization exactly and remove any spaces before or after the code.

faq.question: Why does HAZESEAS2026 fail?
faq.answer: It may work only in newly started servers or may have expired. Rejoin once and try again; if it still fails, treat it as inactive.

meta.breadcrumb: Home > Haze Seas Sea 2 and Sea 3

sea2sea3.intro: Haze Seas has three seas. Sea 2 unlocks at Level 2200 after the Dimensional Sailor quest, while Sea 3 unlocks at Level 4200 after the Gatekeeper's solo Red Emperor trial.
tableRows: Reach Level 2200 to begin the Sea 2 quest
Dimensional Sailor at the Starter Island docks
Bring the Poneglyph Scroll from the central cave at Rocky Pillars
Gatekeeper inside the main building at Flower Capital
Defeat the Red Emperor solo, return to the Gatekeeper, and choose Yes

sea2.h2: How to unlock Sea 2 in Haze Seas
steps: Go to the docks on Starter Island and speak to the Dimensional Sailor.
Enter the central cave and complete the cutscene.
Return to the Dimensional Sailor and give him the Poneglyph Scroll.
Speak to the Dimensional Sailor again to travel to Sea 2.

sea3.h2: How to unlock Sea 3 in Haze Seas
steps: Enter the main building and speak to the Gatekeeper.
Defeat the Red Emperor in the solo trial.
Return to the Gatekeeper after the victory cutscene.
Choose Yes to travel to the Land of the Gods in Sea 3.
